facts.fact: Benin's health ministry awarded a public contract for 20 AI-assisted miLab MAL malaria diagnostic devices for main referral hospitals, after the national malaria programme classified it as a point-of-service diagnostic, per South Korean media reports.

Benin launched on 30 June 2026 a Japan-funded $2.3m malaria project that will use AI with geospatial mapping to find high-risk mosquito breeding areas for drone larvicide spraying in six pilot municipalities, per the government and We Are Tech Africa.
